visual_action: The video displays a meme format using a static image of a small monkey hugging a larger, orange stuffed animal. The small monkey is labeled "Me", and a series of text overlays appear sequentially on the stuffed animal, listing purported accomplishments of President Trump. The video concludes with a different static image of the small monkey sleeping peacefully on the stuffed animal, with the text "Peace through Strength" overlaid.
